description: Publishes a banner announcement on the status page: `title`, `body`, optional `type` (defaults to `info`), optional display window and link. If `started_at`/`ended_at` are omitted, the announcement is shown until it is deleted or ended. Announcements require a plan with `status_page_announcements_enabled` — otherwise 403 `status_page_announcement_not_allowed`.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

ended_at.description: ISO 8601. End of the display window (optional).

link.description: Optional URL shown as a "Подробнее" button in the banner.

started_at.description: ISO 8601. Start of the display window (optional).

name: status_page_announcement_create
title: Create an announcement
